build_queryinst_model: build a QueryInst R50 FPN model config with 300 proposals and multi-scale 480-800 augmentation
configure_train_pipeline: configure a DETR-style training pipeline with random flip, crop, and multi-scale resize augmentations
set_model_test_cfg: set model test config with 300 max proposals per image and binary mask threshold of 0.5
configure_rpn_head: configure RPN head with 300 proposals for QueryInst object detection
setup_train_dataloader: setup train dataloader with custom augmentation pipeline for QueryInst training
